discord.text:
**Newsroom brief: SINGLE-SOURCE REPORT - REUTERS | Reuters reports Southwest cuts 2026 outlook despite quarterly earnings beat [Source 2026-10-21]**

Reuters reports a Southwest earnings beat and a lower 2026 forecast; the test is whether fare gains can keep absorbing fuel costs.

**Context:** The strongest countercase to a failed-turnaround story is in the same report: adjusted operating margin improved despite higher fuel costs.

Read the article: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/pending-publication-857f96cfc5871ccf

Source date: 2026-10-21. Interpretation remains analysis.
